title: Map of Browser Agent Testing tool catalogue
scope: Maintained and materially relevant tools for local browser-agent and iOS-agent testing, grouped by job. Each entry has dated execution evidence or an explicit applicability boundary.

evidence_states.benchmarked: Repeated locally against the shared Vaultwealth journeys or faults.
evidence_states.screened: A bounded local probe was completed, but the tool was not fully qualified.
evidence_states.setup-blocked: A dated setup or run was attempted, but a named prerequisite or bounded failure prevented a fair result.
evidence_states.researched-only: Official sources were reviewed and a concrete fit boundary was recorded; no runtime ranking is claimed.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.note: Qualified web baseline; fixed assertions and visual comparisons.

tools.name: agent-browser
tools.note: Batch reduced its own login overhead; batch edit failed 0/5.

tools.name: Playwright CLI
tools.note: Login and edit passed 5/5 but were slower than the saved baseline.

tools.name: Puppeteer Core
tools.note: Search passed 5/5 at 2.081 s workflow median and detected stale search; fastest added screen, but not a 2x win.

tools.name: Selenium WebDriver
tools.note: Search passed 5/5 at 3.633 s workflow median and detected stale search.

tools.name: Cypress
tools.note: Package pinned; the isolated experiment had no Cypress application binary. No tool-quality claim.

tools.name: WebdriverIO
tools.note: Search passed 5/5 at 2.958 s workflow median and detected stale search.

tools.name: Nightwatch
tools.note: Search passed 5/5 at 5.425 s workflow median and detected stale search.

tools.name: TestCafe
tools.note: Proxy run did not return a test result before the bounded 60 second timeout on this service-worker fixture.

tools.name: Taiko
tools.note: Search passed 5/5 at 23.850 s workflow median and detected stale search; isolated launches were required.

tools.name: CodeceptJS
tools.note: Installed and pinned, but it delegates to Playwright/WebDriver/Puppeteer; no separate driver speed claim after those engines were measured directly.

tools.name: Testplane
tools.note: Applicable WebDriver test runner, but it does not change the underlying driver result measured with Selenium and WebdriverIO.

tools.name: Jev Ultrafast
tools.cost: Cheap paid selector + local text model
tools.note: Authenticated search passed 5/5; password fields are excluded upstream.

tools.name: Stagehand
tools.note: Cached replay reached 2.201 s median, 4/4; authoring took 25.544 s.

tools.name: Pomerado
tools.cost: MIT core / paid model for authoring
tools.note: Generates source-code integrations from website tasks and serves them through MCP. Authoring uses OpenAI models; generated integrations run without model calls. Relevant to reusable workflow execution, but not an independent correctness oracle. No local runtime or speed result; review input coverage, persisted outcomes and site-change failures separately.

tools.name: Browser Use
tools.note: Worked with local Bonsai but passed 4/5 at 90.730 s among successes.

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
tools.note: Fast diagnostic companion; not a journey executor.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.note: Pinned locally; an agent transport over Playwright, not a saved-executor speed replacement.

tools.name: Codex coding agent
tools.note: Stepwise login passed 5/5; the batched instruction arm qualified 0/5.

tools.name: Skyvern
tools.note: Computer-vision and LLM browser workflow platform.

tools.name: LaVague
tools.note: Web-agent framework with browser actions and retrieval.

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.note: Natural-language element and page-data queries.

tools.name: Magnitude
tools.note: Vision-first browser agent; text-only Bonsai is not a fair model.

tools.name: BrowserGym
tools.note: Unifies reproducible web-agent environments; it evaluates agents rather than replacing product test execution.

tools.name: Browser MCP
tools.note: Controls an existing browser through an extension; excluded because the experiment forbids personal browser profiles.

tools.name: OpenAI computer use
tools.note: General screenshot-and-action computer-use model, not a test oracle.

tools.name: Anthropic computer use
tools.note: General computer-use tool requiring an external execution environment.

tools.name: Browserable
tools.note: Self-hostable agent framework; model/orchestration choice rather than a fixed local driver benchmark.

tools.name: Drisp Browser MCP
tools.note: Local browser-control MCP with snapshots and actions; use as an agent interface, not a correctness oracle.

tools.name: Midscene.js
tools.note: AI-driven web and Android automation; the selected Bonsai text model is not a fair vision backend.

tools.name: TestZeus Hercules
tools.note: Agentic browser testing framework; requires model configuration and independent outcome verification.

tools.name: Shortest
tools.note: Natural-language Playwright tests; model reasoning remains the dominant variable for a fair comparison.

tools.name: UI-TARS Desktop
tools.cost: Open source / local or hosted model
tools.note: General desktop GUI agent with browser control; broader than the local web-driver question and still needs an external oracle.

tools.name: Agent TARS
tools.note: General multimodal agent framework, not a deterministic test executor.

tools.name: Harness
tools.note: Experimental browser and mobile agent harness; useful for exploration research, without a qualified Vaultwealth run.

tools.name: Playwright Test Agents
tools.note: Planner, generator and healer agents author Playwright tests; repeat execution remains Playwright.

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.note: Managed remote browsers; Stagehand integration is first-party.

tools.name: Browserless
tools.note: Remote Playwright/Puppeteer browser infrastructure.

tools.name: Steel
tools.note: Open-source browser API for agents and apps.

tools.name: Hyperbrowser
tools.note: Managed browsers and agent infrastructure.

tools.name: Anchor Browser
tools.note: Cloud browsers for agents and automation.

tools.name: AgentLab
tools.note: Reproducible web-agent experimentation on BrowserGym; not an application regression runner.

tools.name: WebArena
tools.note: Self-hosted realistic web tasks for agent research; not a substitute for product-specific assertions.

tools.name: VisualWebArena
tools.note: Visual web-agent benchmark; measures general capability rather than Vaultwealth defect detection.

tools.name: WorkArena
tools.note: ServiceNow task benchmark with an application-specific infrastructure prerequisite.

tools.name: Vitest browser visual assertions
tools.note: Screenshot matching inside Vitest browser mode.

tools.name: Percy
tools.note: Managed cross-browser visual review.

tools.name: Applitools Eyes
tools.note: Managed visual-AI comparison and review.

tools.name: Chromatic
tools.note: Storybook-oriented component visual testing.

tools.name: Argos
tools.note: Visual and accessibility-tree diffs for pull requests.

tools.name: Lost Pixel
tools.note: Sunsetting; useful comparison history, not a fresh adoption recommendation.

tools.name: BackstopJS
tools.note: Self-hosted browser screenshot regression testing.

tools.name: Loki
tools.note: Storybook screenshot regression testing; verify maintenance before adopting.

tools.name: reg-suit
tools.note: Screenshot regression workflow; requires a capture source and does not explore the application.

tools.name: TestivAI OSS
tools.note: Open-source visual testing framework; model and review configuration are additional variables.

tools.name: Odiff
tools.note: Fast image comparison primitive, not a journey runner or visual-understanding agent.

tools.name: Maestro
tools.note: Retained iOS saved-flow baseline.

tools.name: AXe
tools.note: Fast warm runs, but cold accessibility and text-entry reliability blocked adoption.

tools.name: XcodeBuildMCP
tools.note: Useful installed-app probe; full save/relaunch journey was not qualified.

tools.name: XCUITest
tools.note: Vaultwealth checkout lacked an app-owned Xcode UI-test target.

tools.name: Detox
tools.note: Vaultwealth checkout lacked Detox configuration and an app-owned target.

tools.name: Appium
tools.note: Cross-platform W3C WebDriver automation; iOS uses the XCUITest driver.

tools.name: Appium MCP
tools.note: Official MCP layer for Appium mobile automation.

tools.name: Patrol
tools.note: Flutter-focused native integration testing.

tools.name: EarlGrey 2
tools.note: Google iOS UI automation integrated with XCUITest.

tools.name: idb
tools.note: Isolated runtime found the simulator and returned its accessibility tree through ios-simulator-mcp; the broken user-level install was not modified.

tools.name: idb-mcp
tools.note: MCP wrapper around idb for iOS Simulator control.

tools.name: AppleSimulatorUtils
tools.note: Simulator state and permission utility; upstream deprecates overlapping operations in favor of simctl.

tools.name: SimPilot
tools.note: Agent-oriented iOS Simulator automation; requires a separate product-state verifier for defect claims.

tools.name: Wand
tools.note: Fast simulator automation built around private Apple frameworks; unsuitable as the default long-lived baseline without accepting that maintenance risk.

tools.name: ios-simulator-mcp
tools.note: Started with 17 tools, found the dedicated simulator and returned a 6,940-character accessibility description using isolated idb.

tools.name: ios-simulator-mcp by Yael Gilboa
tools.note: Alternative simulator MCP focused on screenshots, taps and accessibility; overlaps XcodeBuildMCP and AXe.

tools.name: iosef
tools.note: Accessibility-first iOS Simulator control; a candidate for a future native screen, but no claim is made beyond interface fit.

tools.name: Mobile MCP
tools.note: Started with 32 tools, found the simulator and listed 27 elements; its temporary device agent was removed after the probe.

tools.name: AutoMobile
tools.note: Agentic mobile exploration project; model cost and nondeterminism require separate accounting.

tools.name: Mobilewright
tools.note: Installed transitively with Mobile MCP; early project, so baseline maturity and API stability remain boundaries.

tools.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PTQ1_0
tools.note: Text helper passed 25/25; no-thinking median 1.082 s at 7.305 GB sampled peak RSS.

tools.name: Prism llama.cpp
tools.note: Pinned runtime used to serve Bonsai locally.

tools.name: Ollama
tools.note: Convenient local model runtime; not benchmarked in this experiment.

tools.name: MLX LM
tools.note: Apple-silicon local model runtime; not benchmarked here.
